description: This file is a Lua script used as a filter for Pandoc, primarily for debugging and inspecting document elements during conversion. It logs information about paragraphs, raw blocks, raw inline elements, and divs, with special handling for summary sections.

methods.name: Para
methods.description: Logs the content of paragraph elements during Pandoc processing, indicating whether the parser is currently inside a summary section.

methods.name: RawBlock
methods.description: Logs raw block elements, detects and tracks when entering and exiting summary sections based on the raw text content.

methods.name: RawInline
methods.description: Logs raw inline elements during processing.

methods.name: Div
methods.description: Logs the classes of division elements.
